chapter.title: Contributor registration
chapter.simpara: Every contributor is registered via a profile file conforming to the contributor schema at documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsd. Profiles live under documentation/07-contributions/01-people/, one directory per contributor named after their GitHub username:

section.title: Validation
section.simpara: Validate a profile's structure against the schema:

Then check the Schematron rules, which cover constraints the schema itself can't express. Compile the rules into a validation stylesheet, then run it against the profile and inspect the report for svrl:failed-assert elements — none means the profile passes:

section.title: DocBook fragment generation
section.simpara: Two DocBook fragments are generated from each profile and committed alongside it: a full author element for document headers, and a name-only one for bibliographies. Pass role=editor to generate the equivalent editor fragments instead, for edited-work cases. Regenerate them with Saxon after any change to the profile:
section.programlisting:
java -jar documentation/tools/saxon/home-edition/12.7/saxon-he-12.7.jar \ -s:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/contributor.xml \ -xsl:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsl \ -o:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/author.gen.xml
java -jar documentation/tools/saxon/home-edition/12.7/saxon-he-12.7.jar \ -s:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/contributor.xml \ -xsl:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsl \ -o:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/author-name.gen.xml \ detail=name
java -jar documentation/tools/saxon/home-edition/12.7/saxon-he-12.7.jar \ -s:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/contributor.xml \ -xsl:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsl \ -o:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/editor.gen.xml \ role=editor
java -jar documentation/tools/saxon/home-edition/12.7/saxon-he-12.7.jar \ -s:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/contributor.xml \ -xsl:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsl \ -o:documentation/07-contributions/01-people/username/editor-name.gen.xml \ role=editor detail=name
